title: THE SEAL SPAWNS AT RANDOM
why: His order of 2026-10-03, given mid-raid: the seal stood in the same far corner of each sector every raid. Each raid now rolls it among the sector landmarks, never the one nearest the first spawn and never one closer than half the farthest, so the cut stays a journey. The roll comes from the raid seed, so the two windows of a pair see the same door and nothing else on the map moves.
now: The seal now spawns at a different landmark each raid.

edits.anchor: // THE SEAL. Not a container: a door you cut at, in the same place every raid.
